title: Newark Library Robotics Showcase
description1: At the Newark Library, Variable Velocity gave a presentation to a full room of kids and families about who we are, what FIRST Tech Challenge is and how a student team builds a competition robot.
description2: After the presentation, we demonstrated our robot live on the floor and invited kids to gather around and see its mechanisms up close, showing them that robotics is something they can do too.
bullets: Presented our team and the FIRST Tech Challenge program to the community
Ran a live robot demo in front of a packed room
Let kids see the robot's mechanisms up close
Encouraged young students to get involved in robotics
